source: UC Davis Postharvest Technology Center - tomato ripening: days to full red colour by ripeness stage and storage temperature
verification_status: TRANSCRIBED during planning from a search-result excerpt. TODO: re-check every number against the original UC Davis page before the demo.
what_this_measures: How fast tomatoes ripen (days until full red colour). It does NOT measure spoilage, shelf life in days, grade loss or price loss.
limits: Table covers only 12.5 to 25 degrees C. Outside this range we return 'outside evidence range' and never extrapolate.
Data is for conventional (mostly US) cultivars. Indian varieties may ripen differently.
The 'light red' stage is not in the table, so it is not supported.
